## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle Western Jìn translation by Bó Fǎzǔ of the canonical narrative of the *parinirvāṇa* of Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī 大愛道 — the Buddha's foster-mother and foundress of the bhikkhunī sangha. The Chinese parallels are T125[52.1] and [T149](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0149) (Huìjiǎn). The Pāli parallel is in *Apadāna* and the Therīgāthā commentary tradition.

**Abstract**

T148 was produced during Bó Fǎzǔ's Western Jìn career (290–305 CE; cf. [KR6a0005](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0005)), recorded in the frontmatter. The Indic source is presumed lost. T148 is, alongside [T5](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0005), one of only a handful of texts securely attributable to Bó Fǎzǔ.
